text: As requested by City Council in its decision on item MM5.1 at the March 29, 30 and 31, 2023 meeting, representatives from OMERS have been invited to give a presentation on Climate and Fiduciary Duties of OMERS to the Infrastructure and Environment Committee.

The Infrastructure and Environment Committee invited OMERS to make an annual presentation to the Committee on the OMERS Climate Action Plan, and requested OMERS to include more detailed climate plan and progress reports along with the annual Presentations.
